title: § 15.209 What claims are not allowed?
text:
§ 15.209 What claims are not allowed?
§ 15.209 What claims are not allowed?
(a) 
Unassigned residences in United States.
(b) 
Business property.
(c) 
Unserviceable property.
(d) 
Illegal possession.
(e) 
Articles of extraordinary value.
(f) 
Intangible property.
(g) 
Incidental expenses and consequential damage
(h) 
Real property.
(i) 
Commercial property.
(j) 
Commercial storage.
(k) 
Minimum amount.
